def VTask.leastOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z, P z → b ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { lb // P lb ∧ ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z } := 
  let ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := Hinh
  let n₀ : Nat := (z₀ - b).toNat
  have h_nonneg₀ : 0 ≤ z₀ - b := by
    apply Hb z₀ hz₀
  have hQ₀ : P (b + n₀) := by
    calc
      b + n₀ = b + (z₀ - b) := by
        rw [n₀, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (z₀ - b) h_nonneg₀]
      _ = z₀ := by simp [Int.add_sub_cancel]
    exact hz₀
  have hQ_inhabited : ∃ n, P (b + n) := by
    use n₀
    exact hQ₀
  let n_min : Nat := Nat.find hQ_inhabited
  let lb : ℤ := b + n_min
  have hP_lb : P lb := by
    have hQ_min : P (b + n_min) := Nat.find_spec hQ_inhabited
    rw [lb]
    exact hQ_min
  have hleast : ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z := by
    intro z hPz
    let m : Nat := (z - b).toNat
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ z - b := by
      apply Hb z hPz
    have h_m : (m : ℤ) = z - b := by
      rw [m, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (z - b) h_nonneg]
    have hQ_m : P (b + m) := by
      calc
        (b + m : ℤ) = b + (z - b) := by rw [h_m]
        _ = z := by simp [Int.add_sub_cancel]
      exact hPz
    have hle_n : n_min ≤ m := Nat.find_min hQ_inhabited hQ_m
    calc
      lb = b + n_min := by rfl
      _ ≤ b + m := by
        apply Int.add_le_add_right (Nat.cast_le.2 hle_n) b
      _ = z := by
        rw [← h_m]
        simp [Int.add_sub_cancel]
    exact this
  ⟨lb, hP_lb, hleast⟩
